bullets.text: Uber Tests Driverless Cars - **Uber** and **Momenta** plan to test fully driverless cars in Munich starting 2026.
InDrive's Super App Ambitions - **InDrive** aims to expand into grocery delivery and other services in frontier markets.
Microsoft Azure Latency Issues - **Microsoft** reports increased latency for **Azure** users after undersea cables were cut.
Apple Watch Ultra 3 Features - The upcoming **Apple Watch Ultra 3** is expected to feature a larger display and 5G connectivity.
iPhone 17 Pro Battery Boost - The **iPhone 17 Pro** will see a significant battery capacity increase, enhancing daily usage.
Volkswagen's Affordable EVs - **Volkswagen** introduces the ID. Cross concept, targeting the low-end EV market.
Koah's AI Monetization Strategy - **Koah** raises $5M to integrate ads into AI applications, aiming for broader monetization.
Mistral AI's Competitive Edge - **Mistral AI** is positioning itself as a leading competitor to **OpenAI** with innovative models.
